geometry.pattern: Compact public UI mixed private side effects into the map controls.
geometry.cause: The same composition was rendered for operator and public contexts.
geometry.avdsContract: A compact control surface must contain actions the current role can complete.
geometry.fix: Public composition filters operator-only panels and private layer affordances before layout.

radii.pattern: Public status and boundary surfaces needed a shared semantic corner treatment.
radii.cause: The initial public boundary was not represented as a named surface.
radii.avdsContract: Semantic status, surface and control radius roles come from the AVDS adapter.
radii.fix: The status, availability boundary and layer control use declared AVDS role surfaces.

typography.pattern: An unavailable workflow was labelled like an operational control rather than a readable boundary.
typography.cause: Configuration language remained visible to a public visitor.
typography.avdsContract: Public copy must use direct, role-appropriate information hierarchy.
typography.fix: The boundary now states that recorded snapshots are available in the local operator runtime.

space.pattern: The market ticker took compact viewport space without serving the OSINT-map task.
space.cause: A shared operator/public bottom anchor remained enabled.
space.avdsContract: Compact composition preserves the primary map viewport and keeps secondary information intentional.
space.fix: Public runtime does not render the market ticker or its toggle.

space.pattern: Desktop map hierarchy was diluted by a bottom market ticker.
space.cause: The ticker rendered independently of the public role.
space.avdsContract: A page-level composition should reserve its anchors for product-relevant information.
space.fix: The final public desktop composition omits the ticker and retains map, layers, health and news surfaces.
